name: The Clocktower of Reversed Time
description: A grand Victorian-style clocktower where time flows backward, with gears spinning in reverse, autumn leaves rising from the ground back into trees, and people walking backwards through the cobblestone square.
prompt: Elaborate Victorian clocktower with massive gears spinning backwards, autumn leaves ascending from cobblestone streets into golden trees, people walking backwards in period clothing, steampunk aesthetic, dramatic lighting, detailed mechanical elements, cinematic composition
caption: What if yesterday was tomorrow? Step into a world where time takes a detour. ⏳
